description: Synthetic demonstration policies with explicit ground truth; does not establish customer-corpus quality.

documents.name: Payment policy
documents.content:
Enterprise invoice terms are 30 calendar days after issue.

SMB invoice terms are 14 calendar days after issue.

New customers must pay a 50 percent deposit before work starts.

Late payment interest is 1 percent monthly, capped at 5 percent of the invoice.

Finance sends the first reminder 7 days after the invoice due date.

documents.name: Leave policy
documents.content:
Full-time employees receive 18 paid annual leave days per year.

At most 5 unused leave days can roll over into the next year.

Rolled-over leave must be used by January 31.

Annual leave requests require 7 calendar days of advance notice.

Paid parental leave lasts 16 weeks for the primary caregiver.

documents.name: Procurement policy
documents.content:
Department managers approve purchases below USD 5000.

The CFO approves purchases of USD 25000 or more.

Purchases above USD 10000 require three written supplier quotes.

Active supplier security reviews are repeated every 12 months.

A purchase order must be issued before goods are ordered.

documents.name: Security policy
documents.content:
Idle user sessions expire after 30 minutes without activity.

Security audit logs are retained for 180 days.

Administrator accounts must use multi-factor authentication.

Suspected security incidents must be reported within 60 minutes.

Service credentials are rotated at least every 90 days.

documents.name: Recovery policy
documents.content:
Database backups run daily at 02:00 UTC.

The recovery point objective for database recovery is 24 hours.

The recovery time objective for database recovery is 4 hours.

Daily database backups are retained for 30 days.

A populated database restore drill is performed quarterly.

documents.name: Travel policy
documents.content:
The standard hotel reimbursement ceiling is USD 150 per night.

Meals during approved travel are reimbursed up to USD 40 per day.

Travel expense claims must be submitted within 10 calendar days after return.

Business-class flights require an itinerary longer than 8 hours.

Train travel reimbursement requires an itemized receipt.

documents.name: Support policy
documents.content:
Severity 1 support incidents are acknowledged within 15 minutes.

Severity 1 support incidents need a workaround within 4 hours.

Severity 2 support incidents are acknowledged within 1 hour.

Severity 3 support incidents are acknowledged within 1 business day.

Scheduled support maintenance begins on Sundays at 02:00 UTC.

documents.name: Data governance policy
documents.content:
Customer financial records are retained for 7 years.

Deletion requests are acknowledged within 3 business days.

Deletion requests are completed within 30 calendar days.

The Data Protection Officer approves exports of personal data.

Production personal data is prohibited in development databases.
